title: Rocky Road Brownies
changes_from_base: Scratch brownie topped with gelatine-free marshmallows, pecans and chocolate chips.
summary: Fudgy brownies topped with toasted gelatine-free marshmallows, pecans and chocolate chips.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with baking paper
heatproof bowl and small pan (or a microwave)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and line the tin.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Melt the butter and chocolate together, whisk in the sugar, salt and vanilla, then beat in the eggs until thick. Fold in the flour and half the pecans.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread in the tin and bake 22-25 min, until a skewer shows moist crumbs.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Scatter over the marshmallows, the rest of the pecans and the chocolate chips and bake 3-5 min more, until the marshmallows puff and turn pale gold.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Let cool completely, then cut into 16 with a knife dipped in hot water.

tips: Choose gelatine-free marshmallows and check the label.
A wet, hot knife cuts through the topping.
Walnuts or almonds work instead of pecans.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
